source: Chapter 713: Between White and Black
target: Capitulum 713: Inter album et nigrum

source: Warned by Termiboros, Lumian sensed something was off.
target: Monitus a Termiboro, Lumian sensit aliquid non esse rectum.

source: The ambusher was slowly making his exit, as if concerned that moving too fast would prematurely alert Lumian to the abnormality.
target: Insidiator lente exibat, quasi sollicitus esset ne nimis celeriter moveretur ut Lumian de inopinata anomalia praepropere certiorem fieret.

source: Strangely, no massive vortex emerged from the dark, empty tunnel’s depths, stopping the ambusher, who had already gone in, from getting pulled into another mirror.
target: Mira re, nullus ingens vortice ex obscuris et vacua cuniculorum profundis emergit, ita impediens insidiatorem – qui iam intraverat – ne in alium speculum traheret.

source: As he watched him go, Lumian glanced at his restored shadow, put away the brass revolver taken from the enemy, and pulled out the Flog boxing gloves from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Spectans eum abire, Lumian umbram restitutam aspexit, revolverum aeneum ab hoste captum deposuit, et manicas pugilisticas Flog e sacculo viatoris extraxit.

source: He put them on at a measured pace.
target: Manicas induit gradatim.

source: A moment later, blazing white flames engulfed Lumian’s body as he transformed into a fiery spear that hurtled towards the ambusher’s back.
target: Momento post, candidae flammae fulgentes corpus Lumiani voraverunt, dum se in hastam ignifera vertit, quae versus dorsum insidiatoris celeriter volabat.

source: The ambusher’s fears came to pass.
target: Timores insidiatoris evenere.

source: He quickly evaded, ready to turn into a shadow and escape into the dark tunnel’s depths with five decoys.
target: Celeriter effugit, paratus ut in umbram se converteret atque cum quinque simulacris in tenebrosas cuniculorum profunditates confugeretur.

source: Then he would trigger Mirror Traversal and get away entirely, returning to a pre‐selected mirror.
target: Tum excitabit Transitus Speculi et omnino evadere poterit, revertens ad speculum praeordinatum.

source: Just then, as the flames making up the burning white spear dissipated, Lumian appeared.
target: Ipsum momento, dum flammae, quae hastam ignis albae efficiebant, dissipatae erant, Lumian apparuit.

source: The ambusher’s shadow came alive, ensnaring the body that hadn’t fully transformed into a shadow, briefly keeping it from dividing into six separate forms.
target: Umbra insidiatoris animata est, involvens corpus quod non plene in umbram conversum erat, tempore brevi impediens ut in sex formas separatas divideretur.

source: It was forced to remain in place.
target: Id coactus est manere in loco.

source: Lumian advanced and dashed in front of the terrified ambusher.
target: Lumian processit et subito ante insidiatorem territum se contulit.

source: He alternated punches, starting the Flogging.
target: Ictus alternavit, incipiens pugnam Flog.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lumian’s initial punch heightened the ambusher’s fear, and the target narrowly freed himself from his shadow’s entanglement.
target: Primus ictus Lumiani auxit timorem insidiatoris, et ille vix se ex vinculis umbrae suae liberavit.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lumian’s next punch instantly set off the enemy’s already tense fear.
target: Proximus ictus Lumiani statim excitavit iam tensum timorem hostis.

source: This wasn’t chance; the ambusher’s fear clearly exceeded normal levels in this situation.
target: Hoc non erat fortuitum; timor insidiatoris clare excedebat limites normales in hoc casu.

source: Lumian, his eyes silver-black, foresaw the corresponding future and exploited this vulnerability.
target: Lumian, oculis argenteo-nigris, praevidebat futurum congruum et hanc infirmitatem opportunitate adhibuit.

source: Fear played out in his mind as he punched.
target: Timor in mente eius manifesta erat, dum percutiebat.

source: Thus, the first punch worsened the situation, and the second significantly raised the odds, successfully triggering the fear.
target: Ita primus ictus rem peioravit, et secundus probabilitates significanter augebat, timorem feliciter provocans.

source: The ambusher went rigid, heart briefly ceasing from the detonating fear.
target: Insidiator rigide evasit; cor eius paulisper ex detonante timore cessavit.

source: His mind blanked, and blood poured from his nose.
target: Mens eius vacuit, et sanguis ex naso effusus est.

source: Seeing this, Lumian took out the ritual sheepskin from his Traveler’s Bag and threw it over the ambusher’s head.
target: Videns haec, Lumian ex sacculo viatoris pelle ovina rituali extraxit et super caput insidiatoris iecit.

source: Right after, he spoke the activation incantation in Hermes: “Sheep!”
target: Deinde verba incantationis activationis in sermone Hermetico pronuntiavit: “Ovis!”

source: Amid a dark flash, the ambusher turned into a sheep with light white and gray wool.
target: Inter obscurum fulgor, insidiator in ovem versa est, quae lana levis, alba et cana habebat.

source: Lumian stared at the fearful sheep with bloodshot eyes.
target: Lumian oculis sanguineis infusis ad ovem territam intuerebat.

source: Removing the Flog boxing gloves and returning them to his Traveler’s Bag, he grinned and said, “So, you think I’ll release you for a measly gun?”
target: Manicas pugilisticas Flog deponens et eas ad sacculus viatoris redigens, subridens dixit: “Itane putas me te liberaturum esse ob vilissimum tormentum?”

source: Lumian then stooped down, scooped up the limp sheep, and went back to the mirror in Moran Avigny’s study, trying to exit.
target: Lumian deinde se inclinavit, ovem mollem arripuit, et ad speculum in studiis Moran Avigny rediit, exitum quaerens.

source: Unable to enter or leave mirrors, he wasn’t certain he could depart so simply.
target: Non potiens specula intrare aut exire, non certo habebat se tam facile discedere posse.

source: If not, he would utilize the pre-prepared Mirror Mark and Spirit World Traversal to go directly to the unique, permanent mirror world exit in Underground Trier.
target: Si non, adhiberet Notam Speculi praeparatam et Transitum Mundi Spiritus ut directe perveniret ad exitum unicum et permanentem mundi speculi in Trier subterraneo.

source: Then he would teleport to locate Franca.
target: Tum se translocabit ad Francam inveniendam.

source: This would avert any issues behind the mirror.
target: Hoc vitaret quaestiones, quae post speculum oriri possent.

source: Lumian’s vision faded and brightened as he emerged in Moran Avigny’s study with the frightened sheep.
target: Visio Lumiani obscurata atque iterum illustrata est, dum in studiis Moran Avigny cum ovibus territis apparuit.

source: He rushed to the window and warily opened it.
target: Festinans ad fenestram accessit et caute eam aperuit.

source: Sure enough, Franca had exited the shadows and waited by the small windowsill.
target: Certe, Franca umbras exierat et iuxta parvum limen fenestrae exspectabat.

source: Realizing Lumian’s Mirror Substitution had shattered, Franca quickly chose to investigate and check if her partner required aid.
target: Intellegens substitutionem speculi Lumiani fractam esse, Franca celeriter decrevit investigare atque perscrutari num socius eius auxilio egisset.

source: "You okay?” Franca whispered.
target: "Esne bene?" Franca susurravit.

source: “We’ll discuss it later.” Lumian threw her the sheep.
target: "Postea de hoc loquemur," Lumian ovem ei iecit.

source: Franca promptly caught the sheep and vanished into the shadows with it.
target: Franca statim ovem arripuit et cum ea in umbras evanuit.

source: In no rush to go, Lumian donned gloves and took care of the various traces he had left behind.
target: Non festinans, Lumian manicas induit et de variis vestigiis, quae reliquerat, curam tulit.

source: Soon, Franca returned, using the Primordial Demoness figurine, her mirror, and Demoness black magic to handle the anti-divination and anti-prophecy part.
target: Mox Franca rediit, utens statuetta daemonissae primordialis, speculo suo, et magica nigra daemonissae ad tractandum partem adversam divinationis et prophetiae.

source: In an abandoned tunnel close to the permanent mirror world entrance in Underground Trier,
target: In cuniculo deserto prope aditum permanentem mundi speculi in Trier subterraneo,

source: Franca, now fully briefed by Lumian, eyed the quivering sheep and said eagerly, “How should we question it? Should I ready a mechanical typewriter like last time?
target: Franca, nunc a Lumiano plene instructa, ovem trementem intuerebat et avidē dixit: "Quomodo eam interrogabimus? Parare ne typographum mechanicum, sicut prius?"

source: “But we’ve run out of truth serum.”
target: "Sed serum veritatis exhaustum est."

source: Anthony, sans gold-rimmed glasses and back in veteran garb, gazed at the sheep for a couple seconds before responding, “I’ll talk with him.”
target: Anthony, sine speculis aureis et in habitu veterano, ovem per paucos momentos intuebatur antequam respondit: "Cum eo loquar."

source: “Should we step out first?” Jenna asked out of caution.
target: "Exire primum debemus?" Jenna propter cautelam interrogavit.

source: Anthony agreed with a nod.
target: Anthony capite annuit.

source: “I don’t mind you observing, but he’ll feel more at ease with less people, facilitating communication.”
target: "Non mihi molestum est te observare, sed ille magis quietus erit cum paucioribus, quod communicationem faciliorem reddet."

source: Concerned our attendance will scare him and impact the Hypnotism?
target: "Curasne, ne praesentia nostra illum terret et processus hypnosi afficiat?"

source: Lumian spun around pensively and exited the sealed dark tunnel alongside Franca and Jenna.
target: Lumian, meditabundus circumvagans, exiit e cuniculo obscuro clauso cum Franca et Jenna.

source: Soon, the sheep appeared with Anthony, no longer as scared and nervous.
target: Mox, ovis cum Anthony apparuit, non iam tam territus et anxius.

source: “You may cancel the Animal Creation Spell,” Anthony told Lumian, smiling. “He realizes we’re acting in his best interest and wishes to assist. Provided we avoid topics that will impact his faith in a deity and directly affect his life, he’ll speak honestly and amiably.”
target: "Licet incantationem creationis animalium revocare," Anthony Lumiano dixit subridens, "intellegit nos in eius utilitatem agere atque ei auxiliari velle. Dummodo argumenta, quae fidem eius in deum afficiant et vitam ejus directe intingant, vitemus, ille sincere et amabiliter loquetur."

source: The sheep nodded gravely, confirming Anthony’s words.
target: Ovis graviter annuit, verba Antonii confirmans.

source: Lumian faced Franca and Jenna, seeing matching emotions in their eyes.
target: Lumian ad Francam et Jennam conversus, eorum oculis similes passiones intuemurens.

source: A Hypnotist is truly terrifying!
target: Hypnotista vere terribilis est!

source: A Spectator is truly terrifying!
target: Spectator vere terribilis est!

source: Indeed… Lumian reflected inwardly.
target: Revera… Lumian introspexit.

source: Looking at the sheep, he uttered the Hermes incantation: “His Grace.”
target: Ovum intuens, verba incantationis in lingua Hermetica edixit: "Eius Gratia!"

source: With a dark flicker, the sheepskin automatically vanished, and the ambusher materialized before Lumian and the others, half-crouched.
target: Ob obscurum micare, pelle ovina automatice evanuit, et insidiator ante Luminum atque ceteros dimidio flexus apparuit.

source: Putting away the sheepskin, Lumian inquired with a smile, “What’s your name?”
target: Pelle ovinam deponens, Lumian subridens rogavit: "Quod nomen tibi est?"

source: “Jebus Lata,” the ambusher answered nonchalantly, like talking to a buddy.
target: "Jebus Lata," insidiator nonchalo respondit, quasi cum amico loqueretur.

source: Holding the carbide lamp, Lumian warmly asked, “Were you guarding Moran Avigny?”
target: Lampadem carbidam tenens, Lumian calide quaesivit: "Moran Avigny custodiebasne?"

source: “Yes,” Jebus Lata replied frankly. “Mainly to conceal myself behind the mirror and watch the outside. Also to prevent mirror world mishaps and ensure Moran Avigny isn’t found out and ambushed when he uses it to do specific things in various locations.”
target: "Ita," aperte respondit Jebus Lata, "praesertim ut me post speculum celarem et extra observarem; item ut casus in mundo speculi prohiberentur et ut Moran Avigny non detegatur atque insidiatus sit, cum ea ad opera specifica in diversis locis utatur."

source: Security is fairly tight. No clear weak points…
target: Securitas satis stricta est. Nulla vulnera perspicua sunt…

source: Franca muttered, taking the lead in displaying her Demoness of Pleasure charm.
target: Franca submurmuravit, praebeens fascinum daemonissae Voluptatis.

source: Grinning, she asked, “Which organization do you belong to?”
target: Subridens, interrogavit: "Ad quam societatem pertines?"

source: Jebus’s eyes were drawn to Franca as he reflexively answered,
target: Ipsi oculi Jebus ad Francam attraxi sunt, et reflexe respondit:

source: “The School of Truth.”
target: "Schola Veritatis."

source: “Truth?” Lumian arched an eyebrow.
target: "Veritas?" Lumian supercilium sublevavit.

source: Jebus didn’t face him, gaze flitting between the two Demonesses.
target: Jebus ad eum non conversus est, oculis inter duas daemonissas volitans.

source: “Yes, Truth.”
target: "Ita, Veritas."

source: Growing serious, he addressed Franca and Jenna in a proselytizing tone, “What do you believe this world’s backdrop is?
target: Gravius consequens, ad Francam et Jennam in tono conversionis dixit: "Quid creditis esse fundamentum huius mundi?

source: Without waiting for the Demonesses’ response, he continued, “It’s not white or black. Not light or darkness.
target: Sine daemonissarum responsione exspectare, continuavit: "Non est album aut nigrum. Non est lux aut tenebra.

source: “It’s the gray between white and black, the mist between light and darkness.
target: Est griseum inter album et nigrum, nebula inter lucem et tenebras.

source: It’s shadows, flux, and chaos!”
target: Est umbra, fluxus, et chaos!

source: Traits of the corresponding pathway? Well-versed in mysticism, Lumian thoughtfully switched gears.
target: Qualia sint lineamenta itineris correspondentis? Peritus in mysteriis, Lumian meditabundus cursum mutavit.

source: “Are you aware of Moran Avigny’s identity?”
target: "Novistine identitatem Moran Avigny?"

source: This was their top priority now.
target: Hoc nunc erat eorum praecipuum propositum.

source: Jebus nodded casually, as if conversing with a friend.
target: Jebus leviter annuit, quasi cum amico colloqueretur.

source: “I am. He’s part of the Tamara family but was swapped with a Mirror Person from Underground Trier.”
target: "Ego sum. Pars est familiae Tamarae, sed commutatus est cum Persona Specularis ex Trier subterraneo."

source: “Then why collaborate with him still?” Franca probed.
target: "Cur ergo adhuc cum eo cooperaris?" Franca interrogavit.

source: Jebus chuckled.
target: Jebus subridens iocose respondit:

source: “Didn't I just say?
target: "Nonne modo dixi?

source: This world’s backdrop isn’t white or black, but gray. If cooperating with Mirror People lets me reach my aim, why not?”
target: "Scaena huius mundi non est album aut nigrum, sed cinerea. Si cooperatio cum Personis Specularibus mihi finem attingere sinit, cur non?"

source: “What’s the School of Truth after?” Lumian swiftly queried.
target: "Quid quaerit Schola Veritatis?" Lumian celeriter interrogavit.

source: Jebus peered at Franca’s face and lake-blue eyes, stating, “We seek to leverage Moran Avigny and other elites to slowly seize control of Intis’s government, letting this nation have order yet shadows, plus a conduit for ordered communication and shadows.
target: Jebus vultum Francae et oculos eius lacustres intuerebat, dicens: "Propositum nostrum est, ut per Moran Avigny et alios electos, paulatim gubernationem Intis occupemus, concedendo huic nationi ordinem sed simul umbras, atque etiam canalem communicationis ordinatae et umbrarum."

source: “We honor the law, but that won’t stop us from uncovering legal loopholes and employing select methods to settle matters pre-litigation.
target: "Legem colimus, sed id nos non prohibebit ut hiatus legales detegamus et modos selectos ad res ante iudicium componendas adhibeamur.

source: “That’s our ideology.”
target: "Haec est nostra ideologia."

source: Jebus seemed to preach to the Demonesses.
target: Jebus videbatur daemonissis praedicare.

source: How ambitious… Jenna sighed inwardly.
target: Quam ambitiosa… Jenna intime suspiravit.

source: Smiling, Lumian asked, “Why control the government?”
target: Subridens, Lumian rogavit: "Cur gubernationem moderari?"

source: “To practice and near the truth, a rite to please it,” Jebus responded fanatically.
target: "Ad veritatem exerciendam et ad eam appropinquantem, ritus ad eam placandam," inquit Jebus fanaticus.

source: “Plus, we must use Intis’s government and others to locate three things.”
target: "Praeterea, debemus gubernationem Intis et cetera adhibere ut tres res inveniamus."

source: “What three?” Franca inquired curiously.
target: "Quae tres?" Franca curiose quaesivit.

source: Jebus gladly obliged her.
target: Jebus libenter respondit.

source: “One, clues to fallen heaven. It’s in the underground ancient sealed city. Only by controlling Intis’s government can we fully unseal it.”
target: "Unum, indicia caeli lapsi. Ea in antiqua urbe subterranea clausa est. Tantum gubernatione Intis eam plene aperire possumus."

source: Fallen heaven… What’s that? Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony shared looks, realizing none had heard the term.
target: "Caelum lapsum… Quid hoc significat? Lumian, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony oculos inter se commutaverunt, intellegentes neminem hanc vocem audivisse."

source: Jebus went on, “Two, Roselle’s final mausoleum.”
target: Jebus deinde dixit: "Duo, mausoleum ultimum Roselle."

source: Emperor Roselle’s mausoleum? Lumian’s pupils widened.
target: "Mausoleum imperatoris Roselle?" Pupillae Lumiani dilatatae sunt.

source: Franca asked eagerly, “Got any clues?”
target: Franca avidē interrogavit: "Habesne indicia?"

source: “I don’t know.” Jebus shook his head honestly. “At minimum, I’ve got zero leads on Roselle’s tomb. No idea if the Overseers have found anything.”
target: "‘Nescio,’ Jebus sincero animo caput movebat, 'ad minus nihil indicum de sepulcro Roselle habeo. Nescio num Inspectores quid invenerint.'"

source: Overseer… Lumian and the rest committed the title to memory.
target: "Inspectores…," Lumian et ceteri titulum in memoria retinuerunt.

source: Jebus glanced from Franca to Jenna, then back to Franca.
target: Jebus a Franca ad Jennam deinde iterum ad Francam respexit.

source: “Three, a lamp. The Magic Wishing Lamp.”
target: "Tria, lampas. Lampas Votaria Magica."

source: Magic Wishing Lamp? Lumian checked Franca, seeing the Demoness of Pleasure also looked blank.
target: "Lampas Votaria Magica?" Lumian Francam aspexit, et notavit Demonissam Voluptatis quoque videri vacuam.

source: Smiling, Jebus added with a showy air, “The Magic Wishing Lamp is a Sealed Artifact.. Its number is: 0-05!”
target: Subridens, Jebus pomposo animo addidit: "Lampas Votaria Magica est artefactum clausum. Numerus eius est: 0-05!"
